name: Dream Dust in the Swamp
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Getting the information on Nazz is quite a favor, adventurer.  Yes, quite a favor.  But you've come all the way from the Shimmering Flats to get it... are you willing to travel some more?

While I contact my sources, why don't you gather something for me, eh?

Hm... what will it be?  How about dream dust, from the dragon whelps of the Swamp of Sorrows.  Yes, I'd love some dream dust for my snuff pouch!

Get it for me, adventurer, and I'll give you the information you seek.
narrative.objectives: Bring 10 Specks of Dream Dust to Krazek in Booty Bay.  Dream Dust is gathered from the dragon whelps of the Swamp of Sorrows.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Well, look at that. You found the dream dust!

And how did you like the swamp, adventurer? It's not easy to get a hot meal there, is it?
narrative.requestItemsText: Back so soon? Do you have my dream dust?
